name: saga-tic-tac-toe
description: Play tic-tac-toe against your AI assistant on a board inside the conversation. A hosted SAGA A2UI example.

listing.longDescription: A game of tic-tac-toe between you (X) and your assistant (O), on a board shown inside the conversation. Click a square to move; the assistant answers by playing the same game. It needs no account. A game is kept for 24 hours under an unguessable identifier and nothing else about you is stored. A free example built with SAGA A2UI.
defaultPrompt: Start a game of tic-tac-toe with me
